INSPECTION OF START INJECTOR TIME SWITCH

MEASURE RESISTANCE OF START INJECTOR TIME SWITCH
(a) Disconnect the connector.
(b) Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between
each terminal.

Between Terminals    Resistance (Ω)    Coolant temperature
STA — STJ    24 — 40    below 30°C (86°F)
                40 — 60    above 40°C (104°F)
